import re
texts = {
"X": """Every coding agent ships a YOLO mode, and you're probably running it daily. The fix for the horror stories isn't approving every command. It's a sandbox.

"LinkedIn": """Claude Code calls it --dangerously-skip-permissions. The community calls it YOLO mode, and most engineers who use coding agents seriously run it every day.

}

banned = ["excited to announce", "read our blog", "our latest post", "check out our latest"]

for name, t in texts.items():
    print("====", name)
    # first person
    fp = re.findall(r"\bI\b|\bI'm\b|\bI've\b|\bmy\b|\bmine\b|\bwe\b|\bWe\b|\bour\b|\bOur\b", t)
    print("first/second person markers:", fp)
    for b in banned:
        if b.lower() in t.lower():
            print("BANNED PHRASE FOUND:", b)
    # urls
    urls = re.findall(r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+", t)
    print("urls:", urls)
    # hashtags
    hashtags = re.findall(r"#\w+", t)
    print("hashtags:", hashtags)
    # markdown
    md_bold = re.findall(r"\*\*.*?\*\*", t)
    md_italic = re.findall(r"(?<!\*)\*[^*\n]+\*(?!\*)", t)
    md_code = re.findall(r"`[^`]+`", t)
    md_heading = re.findall(r"(?m)^#", t)
    md_link = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\([^)]+\)", t)
    print("md_bold:", md_bold, "md_italic:", md_italic, "md_code:", md_code, "md_heading:", md_heading, "md_link:", md_link)
    print()
